Sponsored Brands - Amazon Ads


Sponsored Brands
Sponsored Brands are cost-per-click ads that showcase your brand and a
selection of your products. Sponsored Brands require enrollment in Amazon
Brand Registry.
Ad formats
Three formats are available: product collection, which promotes multiple
products; store spotlight, which drives shoppers to your Store pages; and
video, which features a single product with autoplay video in shopping
results.
Sponsored Brands ads can link to your Amazon Store or to a custom
product landing page. Ads may appear at the top of shopping results, within
results, and below results.
